To resolve the `ingestion_raw_events` Databricks job (job 4822) failure due to a `SchemaMismatchException`, follow the recovery steps outlined in. First, identify the offending file from the exception message, then quarantine the bad partition by moving it to `s3://psiog-raw/quarantine/<date>/`. Next, re-run job 4822 from the Databricks Jobs UI. Finally, once 4822 succeeds, manually re-run job 4830 (`crm_sync`) to refresh the CRM.
